# Criminal comparisons and PDD — editorial verification

Scope: eight requested criminal distinctions, expansion of three existing topic pages, one criminal navigator, one PDD service page, links in criminal landing/services/publications/DTP. Existing design and public contact details retained. No client facts, new claims about attorney outcomes or penalty promises.

Source review completed 2026-10-10 (Europe/Moscow), using the full official Supreme Court files downloaded for this task. Relevant paragraphs checked again against the finished text:

- Bribery: Plenum 09.07.2013 No. 24, para. 24, official consolidated edition 09.12.2025. https://www.vsrf.ru/documents/all/8355
- Theft/robbery: Plenum 27.12.2002 No. 29, paras. 3, 6, 21–23; consolidated 15.12.2022 plus official amendment 16.06.2026 No. 19. https://www.vsrf.ru/documents/all/8242 and https://www.vsrf.ru/documents/all/36033 . Latest amendment does not remove the violence distinction used here.
- Drugs: Plenum 15.06.2006 No. 14, paras. 13–13.2, edition 16.05.2017. Acquisition/storage with proven distribution intent may be an attempt; actual receipt is not always necessary for completed distribution. https://www.vsrf.ru/documents/all/8251
- Official powers: Plenum 16.10.2009 No. 19, paras. 15–19, consolidated 11.06.2020. https://www.vsrf.ru/documents/all/8117 . Do not repeat the old broad statement that motive is irrelevant for every part of Article 286; present page avoids that claim.
- Embezzlement: Plenum 30.11.2017 No. 48, paras. 23–25, consolidated 15.12.2022. https://www.vsrf.ru/files/26106/
- Homicide: Plenum 27.01.1999 No. 1, paras. 2–3, official full text https://www.vsrf.ru/files/11328/ . Official amendment 03.03.2015 No. 9 checked at https://vsrf.ru/files/14829/; changes paras. 7 and 9, not the cited intent distinction.
- Vehicle offences: Plenum 09.12.2008 No. 25, edition 25.06.2024, causal link/subjects and paras. 20–23 on unlawful taking without theft intent. https://www.vsrf.ru/documents/all/8156
- Hooliganism: Plenum 15.11.2007 No. 45, edition 26.11.2024, paras. 1, 1.1, 12–13. https://www.vsrf.ru/documents/all/8202 . Light harm/beatings encompassed by hooliganism do not require cumulative Articles 115/116; medium/grievous harm/death requires separate assessment of concurrence.
- Administrative traffic: Plenum 25.06.2019 No. 20, paras. 15–16, 19–20. https://www.vsrf.ru/files/28027/ . Intent/awareness for leaving an accident, possible contactless involvement, different manoeuvres and causal injury assessment. No unverified fine amounts or universal appeal deadline published.

Prepublication checks: one H1 and canonical per touched HTML file; unique IDs and script inclusions; valid JSON-LD; all internal links and target fragments resolved; sitemap parsed and URL uniqueness confirmed; git diff --check. Responsive topic grid and wrap rules inspected (two columns, one at <=680px); new anchor offsets follow existing 180px/160px rules. Actual Safari/device testing is not claimed.

Publication: update existing Render static site through main; retain the preceding commit 6a22bcec76fcb3b3d4f535dcf47bc194dee86d1c as the rollback baseline. Verify HTTPS content and live browser after deployment; deployment status alone is insufficient.
